sequence_design.phase_1: two learning materials per family run sequentially through normal HTTP Agent tasks with idle synchronization after each task
sequence_design.phase_2: two independent phase_2 materials per family run sequentially through normal HTTP Agent tasks after phase_1 reaches an idle boundary
sequence_design.selection: held by the service for automatic candidate evaluation and never run as a phase task
sequence_design.held_out: four frozen tasks (two per family) cloned independently from each branch snapshot after both training phases finish

split_policy: learning, phase_2, selection, and held-out identifiers are disjoint; each family has two learning and two phase_2 live Agent tasks to reach batch_task_count=2 in both phases; phase_2 materials are not used as selection evaluator examples; held-out code and acceptance are never used to construct Meta-Skills or Task Skills
